entities.summary: Windows Live Writer is a discontinued desktop blog-publishing application that was developed by Microsoft and distributed as part of the Windows Live suite of apps. The last major release of Windows Live Writer was released in 2012 (end-of-life), and the software was completely discontinued in January 2017.
